## Summary
The I³ Command Center is the specialized diagnostic satellite of MT Media AI. It introduces the Invisible Infrastructure Intelligence (I³ System) framework for established private and estate service businesses. The entry diagnostic is the Lux Snapshot ($0 AI Visibility diagnostic), assessing machine discoverability and citation provenance across generative discovery platforms.
